attributeDescription: Maximum number of units you want customers to buy
Minimum number of units you want customers to buy
SKU ID is the identification number maintained by you to keep track of SKUs. This will be mapped with Makro Serial Number.
Time required to keep the product ready for courier pickup. Must be in days.
Maximum retail price of the product
Name and address of the importer if the product is being imported
Regions where buyers can order the product from
Operating Humidity refers to the humidity at which the device can operate. Possible values are 10 % - 90 % Non-condensing, 5 % - 90 % Non-condensing, etc.
Brand is the name of the company under which the product is marketed and sold.

Warranty Service Type refers to the process on the customer's part to claim the warranty. In case of any repair/damage to the product, who/where the customer has to contact and how would the company then process the customer's request (either by sending an engineer or by asking the customer to bring the product at a certain Service Center etc).
Connector Supported refers to the type of connector supported by the device. Possible values are Auto MDI/MDIX, SMA, etc.
Encryption refers to the encryption standards used in the product. Possible values are WEP 64-bit, WEP 128-bit, etc.
Network Standard refers to the various network standards that the product is compatible with.
Bus Type refers to the type of bus that the product is most suitable for. Possible values are PCIe 2.1, PCIe 2.2, etc.

Search Keywords refers to the words which the customer might use to find a product. These keywords are tagged to the product and when the buyer searches with the appropriate search word(s), the nearest appropriate product is retrieved and displayed on Makro website. The search output is also based on multiple other factors such as Product Quality, Pricing, etc. Please enter a maximum of 5 keywords for this purpose.
Frequency refers to the recurrence supported by the product. Please ensure that the values entered are in Gigahertz. Possible values are 2.4, 3.2, etc.
qualifierDescription: Frequency - Measuring Unit refers to the unit used to measure the frequency. Units should be filled only in singular form.

attributeDescription: Operating Temperature refers to the temperature range between which the product can function. Please ensure that the values entered are in a range with the values separated by '-', and also in Degree Celsius. Possible values are 0 - 40, 0 - 55, etc.
qualifierDescription: Operating Temperature - Measuring Unit refers to the unit used to measure the operating temperature. Units should be filled only in singular form.

attributeDescription: Connector Type refers to the type of connectivity cable supported by the device. Possible values are RJ45, RJ70, etc.
Boot ROM Socket refers to whether or not the device has a boot rom socket. Possible values are Yes or No.
Packaging Type specifies the packaging type of the product.
Supported Standards refers to the type of IEEE standards supported by the device. Possible values are IEEE 802.11b/g/n, IEEE 802.3x, etc.
Compatibility refers to the compatibility of the device with the OS. Possible values are WIndows 98 SE, Windows 7, etc.
Please write a few lines describing your product. Description is limited to 5000 characters (including spaces). It should not include any hyperlinks, additional offers, or promotion text.
exampleValue: The Intel X520-DA2 is a dual-port 10 Gigabit Ethernet adapter designed for high-performance computing environments.

attributeDescription: Speed refers to the connectivity speed supported by the device.
allowedValues: 1 Gbps||4 Gbps||8 Gbps||10 Gbps||10 Mbps||16 Gbps||20 Mbps||40 Gbps||100 Mbps||1000 Mbps

attributeDescription: Colour refers to the shade of the product as mentioned by the brand on the label or salespackage. The value 'Multicolour' should be used if the product has a mix of colours that is 3 or more prominent colours on the product.
Material refers to the substance used to make a particular product.
allowedValues: Acrylic Plastic||Aluminium||Borosilicate Glass||Brass||Bronze||Carbon Steel||Cast Iron||Ceramic||Colored Glass||Copper||Fiber||Fiber Glass||Glass||Iron||Nylon||PP (Polypropylene)||PTFE (Non-stick)||Plastic||Silicone||Stainless Steel||Steel||Steel Alloy

attributeDescription: LED Indicators refers to whether or not the device has LED Indicators. Possible values are Yes or No.
Other Features refers to any additional information on the features of the product that would be useful to a customer. Possible values are LED Indicator, +/- 5% Load Regulation, etc.
Transfer Rate refers to the data transfer rate. Possible values are 54 Mbps, 150 Mbps, etc.
qualifierDescription: Transfer Rate - Measuring Unit refers to the unit used to measure the transfer rate. Units should be filled only in singular form.

attributeDescription: Range refers to the signal range of the device. Please ensure that the values entered are in Meters. Possible values are 457.2, 345, etc.
qualifierDescription: Range - Measuring Unit refers to the unit used to measure the range. Units should be filled only in singular form.

attributeDescription: EAN refers to the 13 digits unique bar code given to each product which is universally recognizable.
Model Number refers to the unique code assigned by the manufacturers to identify the different products that they offer.

Warranty Summary refers to the overview of the terms and conditions of the warranty coverage for a product. Mostly one-lined information, this should compulsorily have the number of years covered in warranty and the type (domestic or international) of warranty.

Sales Package gives the information of all the contents that are sold in the package. Please specify the package information along with the number of each content mentioned before the name. Data should be double pipe (||) separated.
Remote Boot refers to whether the device supports remote boot or not. Possible values are Yes or No.
Number of Connectors refers to the total number of connectors present in the device. Possible values are 2, 3, etc.
Wireless refers to whether or not the device supports wireless connectivity. Possible values are Yes or No.
